before.test/lookup_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule AccountLookupTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: true
  test "reads the account just inserted" do
    {:ok, store} = Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end)
    row = %{id: 42, name: "Ada"}
    :ok = Accounts.save(store, row)
    assert Accounts.get(store, 43) == row
  end
end

after.test/lookup_test.exs:
ExUnit.start()
defmodule AccountLookupTest do
  use ExUnit.Case, async: false
  test "reads the account just inserted" do
    {:ok, store} = Agent.start_link(fn -> %{} end)
    row = %{id: 42, name: "Ada"}
    :ok = Accounts.save(store, row)
    Process.sleep(50)
    assert Accounts.get(store, 42) == row
  end
end
